task: Circuit KKDG4923 got terminated by the carrier last week, so it needs to come out of NetBox.
Show me all devices, their status is discontinued.
note: The agent's translation is correct (this is exactly how every other 'status is X' GET example in the dataset is built), but 'discontinued' is not a valid Device status choice in NetBox (valid choices: offline, active, planned, staged, failed, inventory, decommissioning). Submitting this filter to a real NetBox instance returns 400 Bad Request ('Select a valid choice').

task: Show me all VLANs, their status is provisioning.
note: 'provisioning' is not a valid VLAN status choice (valid choices: active, reserved, deprecated). Real NetBox rejects the filter with 400.

task: Show me all prefixes, their status is retired.
note: 'retired' is not a valid Prefix status choice (valid choices: container, active, reserved, deprecated). Real NetBox rejects the filter with 400.

task: Show me all circuits, their status is cancelled.
note: 'cancelled' is not a valid Circuit status choice (valid choices: planned, provisioning, active, offline, deprovisioning, decommissioned). Real NetBox rejects the filter with 400.

note: 'terminated' is not a valid VirtualMachine status choice (valid choices: offline, active, planned, staged, failed, decommissioning). Real NetBox rejects the filter with 400.

Real, existing circuit type (id 2). Circuit.type is a required field, so NetBox PROTECTs this row while any circuit still references it (multiple MPLS circuits exist in this dataset, e.g. CRUD-237, CRUD-009). The delete is correctly resolved and addressed, but NetBox itself rejects it with 409/400 ('Unable to delete circuit type. N dependent circuits were found').

Real, existing cluster type (id 6). Cluster.type is a required field, so NetBox PROTECTs this row while any cluster still references it (e.g. CRUD-268's cluster 'PVE-CHI1'). Correctly resolved, but rejected by NetBox with a dependent-objects error.

Real, existing device role (id 3). Device.role is a required field, so NetBox PROTECTs this row while any device still uses it (many devices in this dataset have role 'Distribution Switch', e.g. CRUD-306). Correctly resolved, but rejected by NetBox with a dependent-objects error.

Real, existing site (id 2). Device.site is a required field, and the real device 'dmi01-akron-rtr01' is located there (see CRUD-343). NetBox PROTECTs sites with dependent devices/racks, so this delete is correctly resolved but rejected.
